princile: The C07P suite implements prereg expectations P1-P10, N1-N12, C1-C4, T1-T14 frozen at commit 82ba75680. Its first execution produced 6 literal REDs. Those 6 are PRESERVED in observations/c07p_suite_v1.{xml,log} and were NOT deleted, xfailed or suppressed. Each was adjudicated. All 6 were defects in MY TESTS, not in the adapter and not in the pinned OC6 custody source. Only those 6 were corrected, each to assert the preregistered behaviour more accurately. No pinned source byte, no accepted court, and no preregistered expectation was weakened.

corrections.reviewer_did: mutated each field by type branch with `isinstance(current,int)` tested before `isinstance(current,bool)`, so a False lifecycle flag became the integer 1
corrections.observed: native validate_capsule_fields correctly raised TypeError on the now non-bool field, so the test errored before reaching its assertion
corrections.correction: added a `perturb()` helper that tests bool FIRST, so every field is changed to another VALID value of its own declared type, which is what prereg P5/N13 actually require
corrections.strength: unchanged or stronger — the assertion still requires every one of the 18 fields to change the commitment

corrections.reviewer_did: re-sealed only the single tampered record, which broke the prev-chain of every later record
corrections.observed: the journal was correctly refused earlier, by the chain check, with 'prev chain break'
corrections.correction: added a `reseal()` helper that recomputes prev/seq/rec across the whole chain, so the per-record digest and the chain are both consistent and only the capsule-commitment check can catch the forgery
corrections.strength: stronger — it isolates the deeper defence instead of accepting the shallower one

corrections.reviewer_did: prepended a forged record built with seq=1 in front of a 6-record journal
corrections.observed: the journal was correctly refused by the sequence check ('record 2: seq is 1, expected 2')
corrections.correction: the journal now contains ONLY the forged EXPOSURE at seq 1 with prev=ZERO, so restore reaches the native escrow and raises IdentityMismatchError for the ghost capsule
corrections.strength: stronger — it now exercises the intended native refusal rather than an incidental chain refusal

corrections.reviewer_did: asserted PurposeViolationError for a capsule whose purpose was SOURCEFREE_TEST_ONLY, which is legal
corrections.observed: DID NOT RAISE — the module was correct
corrections.correction: the legal-purpose commit is now asserted to SUCCEED, and only the purpose-mutated capsule is asserted to be refused
corrections.strength: stronger — it now proves both the positive and the negative

corrections.reviewer_did: filtered the prefix by record kind, but that filter matched every kind present, so nothing was removed
corrections.observed: assert ['cap-A','cap-B'] == ['cap-A'] — cap-B was still present because the rollback never happened
corrections.correction: the prefix is now selected by ownership of cap-A (reading capsule_id from the nested capsule payload for COMMIT records) and re-sealed into a fully valid self-consistent journal, which is what a real rollback attacker would leave behind
corrections.strength: stronger — the demonstrated ceiling is now a genuine, valid, self-consistent rollback rather than an unchanged file

corrections.reviewer_did: removed the phaseA call that implicitly created the tmp directory, then wrote into it

not_done: no pinned OC6 custody_protocol.py byte altered
no accepted OC6/OC7 court edited, xfailed, skipped or suppressed
no preregistered expectation relaxed to accept weaker behaviour
no lexical or Unicode leakage gate widened
no internal EscrowState dictionary mutated to forge restored authority

discrimination_and_mutation_evidence.note: Unlike OC7, this suite does NOT discriminate the OC4 and OC6 custody blobs. C07P exercises the additive journal adapter plus the native public API, and both blobs expose that API, so OC4 scores 28/30 and OC6 30/30 (the two differences are the P9 provenance pin and a harness artefact). Claiming blob-contrast discrimination here would be false. The correct control for this suite is ADAPTER MUTATION, which was run instead.

mutants.change: neuter the per-record digest comparison in verify_chain
neuter the capsule-commitment re-check on restore
replace os.replace with a non-atomic plain write

discrimination_and_mutation_evidence.conclusion: Each adapter defence is independently load-bearing and is killed by exactly the intended test. The suite is not trivially green.
